violations.description: Preventing contamination by employees. — --Employee's single-use gloves were not discarded after being damaged or soiled. Employee observed using same single use gloves between kitchen tasks and restocking buffet line. Gloves need to be changed between tasks and when dirty.

Plumbing system. — --Plumbing system was not designed, constructed, operated and/or maintained according to regulation. Hand washing sink temped at 140F. Hand washing sink should maintained between 110F and 120F to avoid scalding and encourage proper hand washing.
Properly designed, located, constructed, operated, maintained, cleaned and chemical test kit provided (2 pts deducted)
